grid.expression: SELECT PRC.NROLOTE AS FICHA, PRC.NUMPS AS PLANO, PRC.DHINST AS DTINICIO, PRC.DTPREVENT AS DTPREVENTREGA, PRC.DHTERMINO AS DTFINALIZA, PRC.IDPROC, PRC.IDIPROC, IPA.CODPRODPA AS CODPROD, IPA.QTDPRODUZIR AS QTDTOTAL, IPA.CONCLUIDO AS STATUSCONCLUSAO, PRO.AD_REFINTERNA AS MODELO, (CASE WHEN PRO.AD_LINHA = 1 THEN 'Linha 1' WHEN PRO.AD_LINHA = 2 THEN 'Linha 2' ELSE 'Sem info' END) AS LINHA, ( SELECT MAX( LMP.CODPRODMP ) FROM TPRLMP LMP INNER JOIN TGFPRO MP ON LMP.CODPRODMP = MP.CODPROD INNER JOIN TGFGRU GRU ON MP.CODGRUPOPROD = GRU.CODGRUPOPROD AND GRU.CODGRUPOPROD = 2550000 WHERE LMP.CODPRODPA = IPA.CODPRODPA AND SUBSTR(TO_CHAR(LMP.CODPRODMP), 1, 1) = '2' AND LMP.IDEFX = EFX.IDEFX ) AS CODPRODPLACA, EFX.DESCRICAO AS SETOR, TRUNC(APO.DHAPO) AS DTAPONTAMENTO, SUM(NVL(APA.QTDAPONTADA, 0)) AS QTDAPONTADA, NVL(TRUNC(APO.DHAPO), PRC.DTPREVENT) AS DATA_EIXO FROM TPRIPROC PRC INNER JOIN TPRIPA IPA ON PRC.IDIPROC = IPA.IDIPROC INNER JOIN TGFPRO PRO ON IPA.CODPRODPA = PRO.CODPROD INNER JOIN TPRLPA LPA ON IPA.CODPRODPA = LPA.CODPRODPA AND PRC.IDPROC = LPA.IDPROC INNER JOIN TPREFX EFX ON LPA.IDPROC = EFX.IDPROC/* AND EFX.DESCRICAO IN ('APONTAMENTO INSERSORA','APONTAMENTO REVISORA','INSERÇÃO','SOLDA','TESTE','DISSIPADOR','TAMPA/GABINETE','MONTAGEM FINAL','EXPEDIÇÃO/CONFERENCIA','DISPLAY','PRODUÇÃO KIT IBM')*/ LEFT JOIN TPRIATV TV ON TV.IDIPROC = PRC.IDIPROC AND TV.IDEFX = EFX.IDEFX LEFT JOIN TPRAPO APO ON APO.IDIATV = TV.IDIATV AND APO.SITUACAO = 'C' LEFT JOIN TPRAPA APA ON APA.NUAPO = APO.NUAPO WHERE (PRC.NROLOTE = :P_NROLOTE OR :P_NROLOTE IS NULL) AND EFX.DESCRICAO IN :P_DESCRICAO AND PRC.NROLOTE >= (TO_CHAR(SYSDATE, 'YY') || '00000') AND PRC.NROLOTE <= (TO_CHAR(SYSDATE, 'YY') || '99999') --AND SUBSTR(TO_CHAR(PRC.NROLOTE), 1, 2) = TO_CHAR(SYSDATE, 'YY') AND (PRC.NUMPS = :P_NUMPS OR :P_NUMPS IS NULL) AND (PRC.DTPREVENT >= :P_DTPREVENT.INI OR :P_DTPREVENT.INI IS NULL) AND (PRC.DTPREVENT <= :P_DTPREVENT.FIN OR :P_DTPREVENT.FIN IS NULL) GROUP BY PRC.NROLOTE, PRC.NUMPS, PRC.DHINST, PRC.DTPREVENT, PRC.DHTERMINO, PRC.IDPROC, PRC.IDIPROC, IPA.CODPRODPA, IPA.QTDPRODUZIR, IPA.CONCLUIDO, PRO.AD_REFINTERNA, PRO.AD_LINHA, EFX.IDEFX, EFX.DESCRICAO, TRUNC(APO.DHAPO) ORDER BY PRC.NROLOTE, PRC.DTPREVENT, TRUNC(APO.DHAPO)
